title: NASA's Venus fact sheet: orbit 224.701 days, surface pressure 92 bars
summary: The sheet lists Venus's mass as 4.8673 × 10^24 kg, equatorial radius 6051.8 km, mean density 5243 kg/m^3, surface gravity 8.87 m/s^2, and sidereal orbit 224.701 days.
body: The sheet lists Venus's mass as 4.8673 × 10^24 kg, equatorial radius 6051.8 km, mean density 5243 kg/m^3, surface gravity 8.87 m/s^2, and sidereal orbit 224.701 days. It prints the sidereal rotation period as −5832.6 hours and does not, on the page read, define that minus sign. The atmosphere section states a surface pressure of 92 bars. The sheet lists zero natural satellites. Author of the sheet: Dr. David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Last updated on the page: 2024-01-11.
